name: Brex
verdict: OAuth client credentials need partner onboarding with Brex developer support. Without it, each customer's admin creates a user token and pastes it in, which works but is manual and tied to a user; timeline unknown.
needGuide: Yes — contact Brex developer support to apply as a partner, and use user tokens in the meantime.

auth.detail: Two models. User tokens: a Brex account admin or card admin creates a token under Developer → Settings with chosen scopes, sent as a Bearer header; it expires if unused for 90 days or if its user is deactivated. Partner OAuth 2.0 (OpenID Connect compliant): authorization code (PKCE optional) for most APIs and client credentials for the onboarding API; access token 1 hour, refresh token rotated and valid 90 days; revoke at /v1/revoke.

effort.timeToFirstTest: 15–30 min with a user token on your own Brex account; OAuth: depends on partner onboarding

approval.gate: Partner onboarding with Brex developer support is required to get OAuth client credentials. Without it, each customer's admin creates a user token and pastes it into your app (works but manual and tied to a user).

scopes.why: Space-delimited scopes, and the granted set can be a subset of what you asked for.
scopes.summary: Space-delimited scopes (for example cards, cards.readonly); the granted set may be a subset of the requested one. Per-API scope tables are in Brex's scopes guide. User tokens select scopes at creation.

cost: No fees documented; partner terms unknown
prerequisites: Account and owner: A business or partnerships owner to request client credentials from Brex developer support; developers implement. A Brex account of your own is likely needed for testing.

Where you register: No self-serve console for OAuth: contact Brex developer support to receive a client ID and secret and supply redirect URIs. User tokens: Brex dashboard → Developer → Settings (account admin or card admin).
Cost: No fees documented; partner terms unknown

registerAt.path: No self-serve console for OAuth: contact Brex developer support to receive a client ID and secret and supply redirect URIs. User tokens: Brex dashboard → Developer → Settings (account admin or card admin).

steps.do: Contact Brex developer support and apply as a developer partner; supply redirect URIs
Receive client ID and secret; read the openid-configuration document for the live base URL
Implement authorization code flow (state longer than 8 characters, optional PKCE) and the /v1/token exchange
Store refresh tokens and rotate them before the 90-day expiry
Test on staging, or with a user token against a test Brex account
Have a customer admin approve the requested scopes and verify the integration end to end

roles.team: A business or partnerships owner to request client credentials from Brex developer support; developers implement. A Brex account of your own is likely needed for testing.
roles.customer: A Brex user with the proper role (an admin) signs in and approves some or all requested scopes; roles without that permission cannot grant access. For user tokens, an account admin or card admin creates the token.

testing: The authentication page says Brex offers only a production API server (api.brex.com), while the partner OAuth page mentions a staging environment with no availability guarantee and data that may be purged.
Ask your Brex partner contact for staging access.

blockers.fix: Plan for partner onboarding, or use customer-created user tokens meanwhile.
Rotate before expiry or the user must sign in again.
State must be longer than 8 characters.

blockers.problem: Existing partners may still be on the old OAuth base URL (new one enabled 2022-11-17)

automation.agentCan: Write the OAuth code, refresh scheduler and revocation handling; run staging tests; draft the partner application and use-case description.
automation.humanMust: Brex partner application and agreement, a customer admin approving consent or creating a token, and any commercial terms.

uncertain: Partner acceptance criteria and timeline, partner fees, scope tables, whether staging is available to new partners.
